reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Entergy
reauth_confirm.description: Entergy rejected the password for {username}. Enter the current password. The existing account, sensors, and energy statistics are kept.

error.mfa_required: Entergy requested an additional login step that this integration does not support yet.
error.no_accounts: Login worked, but no accounts were returned.
error.account_missing: That password signed in, but it does not have access to the account already configured for this entry.

abort.reauth_successful: Password updated. Entergy polling will resume and existing statistics are kept.
abort.already_configured: This Entergy account is already configured.

init.title: Entergy Options
